bio: This place boasts an enviable location in the old town and, in summer, the terrace overlooking the River Reuss beckons – the views are stunning! You will find a chic setting in both the restaurant and the Bar & Lounge. On the menu: specialities from the barbecue as well as French and Mediterranean dishes, all made with top-quality regional and seasonal ingredients. The restaurant is located in the gorgeous Hotel Des Balances, so why not stay the night?...
